cohort: The study included 852 women with GDM and 3,803 controls without GDM, from five ethnic groups (Caucasian, East-Asian, Latin-American, Moroccan, and South-Central Asian) who gave birth between May 2013 and July 2017.
finding: GDM is an independent predictor of macrosomia in Latin-American, South-Central Asian, and Moroccan women, but not in Caucasian or East-Asian women where other factors, such as excessive gestational weight gain, play a more important role.
